name: studio-paths-terrain-save
description: (2): Studio's terrain editor moves every selected object (selectAll, Numpad6), saves (editors.saveAll) and packs; the editor opens that map (from: studio) and re-saves; (4) the regenerated war3map.lua of that save. war3map.doo: Studio's save writes it as version 13 (dooversion.ts, branch feat/doo-v13-upgrade), so only the extras of the doodads whose model has a light are ignored (the editor's save gives them the light, Studio's doesn't); the units file's ignores as before. Units: expected to differ in the height of the neutral buildings (tavern, marketplace, goblin merchant, shop, mercenary camps, ntrt/ntrg) the editor's save puts up to 5.2 off Studio's (the stored height, or after a move the ground at the point); units 5, 13, 14, 18, 27, 32, 54, 67, 73, 75, 77, 81, 87, 88, 89, 92, 97 (measured 2026-11-17). Since the save's elevation sample points (objheights.ts unitGround, commit b1cb0a28) only two are left, the tavern ntav 13 (WE 426.89, Studio 426.84) and the mercenary camp nmer 54 (263.65 against 264.05), in two runs of branch we-compare-17 (2026-11-19); every other unit's height must match

steps.eval: const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !s.placedObjects()?.doodads?.length; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); [...document.querySelectorAll('.terrain-tab')].find((b) => b.textContent === 'Select').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); await w3.commands.execute('w3.terrain.selectAll'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); const xs = () => (s.placedObjects()?.doodads ?? []).map((d) => d.position[0]); const before = xs(); const c = document.querySelector('.model-stage canvas'); c.focus(); for (const type of ['keydown', 'keyup']) c.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent(type, { key: '6', code: 'Numpad6', bubbles: true })); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 800)); const after = xs(); const moved = after.filter((x, i) => x > before[i]).length; if (!moved || after.length !== before.length) throw new Error(`Numpad6 moved ${moved} of ${before.length} doodads (now ${after.length})`); await w3.editors.saveAll();

name: studio-paths-matrix-masks
description: (5) MatrixPCDefense_v4.3 (all-zero ally masks in its w3i; the editor refuses it without a war3map.wtg, so make-studio-paths.mjs adds echo's): the editor's save against Studio's pack. Differs for the editor's own reasons, not the masks: the map has no placed units, so the editor places start locations of its own (player 0 at -8960,-3968; the w3i says -3400,6300) and writes them and the masks worked out from them into the w3i at random: player 0 at -8960,-3968 in one run, -490,5669 in the next (2026-11-17), so the masks worked out from them are random too and are ignored (that they agree with allies.rs's rule for the editor's starts was seen by hand once); the editor counts that change as an edit (saves 1 to 2). Also ignored: scriptType, supportedModes, gameDataVersion and the enemy masks, which the editor's newer w3i version has and the map's version 25 hasn't. Checked: the starts and saves are what differs. The editor writes the player and force names as TRIGSTR_ strings of the borrowed wts, and Studio's pack does too since branch we-compare-16 (namesToStrings); force 2's Horde refers to player 9's string 9 in both since branch we-compare-17 (Studio made a string 11 of its own: a repeated text refers to the first string, plain-names-c)
